summary: Docker Engine 29.6.2 inside Ubuntu-24.04 WSL2 passed the deep doctor, Docker-Wine RDP desktop, Wine Notepad input, the real NSIS installer, and Evergreen WebView2 157.0.4341.60 provisioning. Wine 11.21 plus matching Staging made the installed Octane Tauri/WebView2 UI conditionally visible after three resize/minimize/restore repaint cycles. The unpatched Staging control passed one full clean scenario and remained black in the next. The visible-region candidate rendered the real Octane UI and 8/6/1/176/0 Rust workload in 3/3 fresh runs, but the complete native-dialog/export-no-overwrite scenario passed only 1/3. The minimal native WebView2 probe remained white in the baseline, control, and candidate. The result is not yet demonstrated repeatably.
conditionalFinding: Real installed Octane GUI and Rust workload were demonstrated under the pinned Wine-Staging 11.21 visible-region candidate, but only with an intrusive three-cycle repaint helper; native-dialog and complete export acceptance were not repeatable.

evidenceSummary: Measured 2026-11-14 on Windows 11/WSL2/Docker with the unchanged retained installer. Baseline Wine 11.0 remained blank. Pinned Wine-Staging 11.21 sometimes presented the installed Octane client after three window-state cycles. The control was full-pass 1/2; the visible-region candidate was GUI/workload 3/3 but complete dialog/export acceptance 1/3. The native probe remained white in every tested profile. All run bundles have per-file SHA-256 manifests, JUnit/JSON stage results, screenshots, logs, and exact cleanup state.
finalScreenshotCaption: Wine-Staging 11.21 candidate: the real installed Octane client rendered 8 files, 6 groups, 1 duplicate set, and 176 bytes after three repaint cycles; this run passed, but later fresh runs did not repeat every dialog/export gate.
nextMilestone: Add a minimal native IFileOpenDialog/GetOpenFileName diagnostic under the same candidate prefix and record HRESULT/window lifecycle to separate Wine common-dialog behavior from Tauri/rfd. Do not promote the profile unless native presentation, picker cancellation, save/overwrite, export validation, and cleanup pass in three independent fresh runs without selectively discarding failures.
